A small, explicit release

TraceRook is preparing an initial ten-tester beta for Apple Silicon Macs running macOS 26 or later. No public download is published here. The native dashboard, offline Cloud Demo, authenticated local service, and synthetic Local API Demo are implemented. The production Cloud API is deployed with HTTPS unauthenticated rejection verified and 55 Worker tests passing. Genuine hosted inference receipts and final native Cloud evidence remain pending. Claude Code 2.1.290 passed actual callback allow/deny, bounded timeout, and high-risk outage checks using a local model double. Codex remains unverified.

Demo results are samples. Cloud connectivity and verified pre-execution host coverage are separate states. Automated installation, repair, uninstall, and billing are outside this release.

An invited Cloud session

Open Settings → AI Provider → TraceRook Cloud, enter the access code provided separately by the owner, and accept the displayed consent. Credentials remain only in background-service session memory; access must be entered again after that service restarts. No Keychain access occurs. Direct BYOK remains unavailable.

Enrollment, Cloud selected for host analysis, operator availability, and an actual validated Claude response are separate states. Use the explicit pause/resume controls. Demo and Local selections pause service Cloud analysis first; if the service is unavailable, Demo shows a persistent warning that background analysis state cannot be verified.

The remote payload contains coarse task/action categories and enumerated local signals. Raw commands, code, file contents, paths, and transcripts are excluded. Never put access codes in agent configuration or bug reports.

Verify your release

The owner supplies a versioned ZIP, JSON manifest, and matching SHA256SUMS. Keep them together and run the command below from that folder. Both entries must report OK. The manifest records the original app version/build independently of the beta archive label.

shasum -a 256 -c TraceRook-0.1.0-beta.1-macOS-arm64-SHA256SUMS

Open a non-notarized app

This beta retains ad-hoc signatures. It has no Developer ID identity and is not notarized by Apple. Signature verification checks integrity, not publisher identity or Apple malware review.

  1. Verify the source and checksum, then expand the ZIP with Archive Utility.
  2. Move TraceRook.app to Applications using Finder and attempt to open it.
  3. If macOS blocks it, use System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway and confirm the named app, following Apple's documented workflow.

Managed Macs may disallow an exception. Do not disable Gatekeeper globally or remove quarantine attributes. Report malware or damaged-app warnings to the owner.

Start with visible evidence

Explore the labeled Demo view first. Installing an agent does not enable protection. Before configuring a host, read the agent compatibility guide and the exact tested manual scope supplied with your invitation. A missing, skipped, or late hook can permit execution; native agent permissions remain independent.

Report the release version, macOS and agent versions, visible integration status, and reproduction steps through your invitation's feedback channel. Review logs and screenshots for secrets before sharing. The intended alpha price is $20/month; payment collection and subscriptions are not implemented.

Based on the MVP1 specification, the additive MVP2 specification, and the acceptance matrix · October 8, 2026.
